title: Woman Accuses Cop of Harassment After Getting Arrested in a Towel
description:
On February 6th, 2022, an officer on patrol noticed a vehicle with a broken headlight. He quickly conducted a traffic stop, but by that time, the passenger and the driver of the vehicle had switched seats. One of the officers suspected that something fishy was going on, so he asked both of them to exit the vehicle. The woman continued to argue with the officers. Shortly after, the officers helped her get some clothes on. Both of them were charged with several traffic crimes and resisting arrest.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
